en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden church with a central tower topped by a cross and star finial. The building has a metal roof, tall arched windows, classical details on the tower cornice, and is partly obscured by trees and a small fenced area with a monument. The sky is mostly clear with scattered clouds. Printed captions on the image identify the church and the publisher/photographer.
